item.prompt: Low mood in the last two weeks

guidance: A sufficient answer records whether low mood has been present in the last two weeks and, if so, roughly how often. A formal decline is a valid resolution and must be recorded as declined, not as an answer. Offer no suggested wording for this item.

label: insufficient
